name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
description: When four pet turtles were bathed in alien ooze, they began to mutate and became the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles. Raised in New York City sewers by their foster father and wise sensei, Master Splinter, Leonardo, Michelangelo, Donatello, and Raphael wage war against crime. Led by Master Splinter, the four turtles learn the ancient martial art of Ninjitsu, mastering skills of stealth, weapons, and fighting. They stop evildoers in all forms, whether barbaric gangs, lowlife crooks, deranged cyborgs, or even the crime syndicate The Foot, led by their archrival, The Shredder.

videos.title: Insane in the Membrane
videos.overview: The mutant outbreak continues to spread throughout the sewers and subway tunnels while the Turtles try to contain the threat. Back at Area 51, Baxter Stockman prepares a new body for cerebral transfer despite warnings from Agent Bishop. When Stockman's body begins to show signs of rejection, he becomes delirious, which leads to a rampage against the person he believes to have caused all his problems, April O'Neil. In the end, seeing April as his mother due to his delusions, Stockman sacrifices himself by being drowned in the East River while handing her to the Turtles and Casey.

videos.title: Turtles Forever
videos.overview: Whoa, dude! Worlds collide when the Turtles from one dimension meet the Turtles from another dimension! What the shell is going on? The two Turtle teams must work together to find the Technodrome and undo this multi-dimensional mess! Meanwhile, Shredder sets out to track down his counterpart, Ch'rell, who devises a master plan to travel back to the Prime Universe to wipe all the Turtles out of existence! Get ready for two times the Turtle Power as the teams seek guidance from two versions of Splinter, meet classic characters like Casey and April, and face a slew of enemies!

videos.title: Mayhem from Mutant Island
videos.overview: During a night of showing off their extreme sports gear, the Turtles are attacked by a monster from beneath the Earth. They trace the beast to a remote island where they uncover their old foe, Dr. Baxter Stockman, who has created vicious monstrosities to unleash on the unsuspecting public.

videos.title: Things Change
videos.overview: In their underground lair deep beneath the city streets, the Turtles and Master Splinter are suddenly attacked by a horde of Mouser robots!

videos.title: A Better Mousetrap
videos.overview: The Turtles discover the source of the Mouser robots that trashed their old lair: Dr. Baxter Stockman -- a noted technological genius/inventor, who tries to pass off the Mousers as a means to eradicate the city's rat problem.

videos.title: Attack of the Mousers
videos.overview: When April O'Neil wakes up in the Turtle's lair she has major trouble dealing with the reality of four giant talking Turtles and a Zen-master rat. She soon learns of the origin of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles and they realize their common enemy is Baxter Stockman and his army of robotic Mousers.

videos.title: Meet Casey Jones
videos.overview: Raphael is a little cooped up underground with only his brothers and Master Splinter. When Raphael almost clobbers Michelangelo in some brotherly sparring, it's apparent that Raphael needs to get out ... let off a little steam. But when he meets up with Casey Jones, a vigilante erring a little to the right of justice, Raphael must face the reality of his own hothead ways...

videos.title: Nano
videos.overview: When a scientist accidentally unleashes a super-powered Nanotech monster with a childlike mind, it adopts a small-time thief as its father figure, and the mayhem begins!

videos.title: Darkness on the Edge of Town
videos.overview: The Turtles, investigating a strange blackout, discover the Foot Ninja stealing a Japanese ceremonial sword from the Metropolitan Museum of Art.

videos.title: The Way of Invisibility
videos.overview: After Casey Jones makes himself an unwanted guest in the Turtles' lair, Raphael takes him topside for a "breath of fresh air", where they encounter the Foot Tech Ninjas.

videos.title: Fallen Angel
videos.overview: On a nightly training run, the Turtles and Casey Jones break up a Purple Dragon robbery. One of the perps is Angel, a girl Casey knows from the neighborhood who's going through her initiation rites to become a Purple Dragon.

videos.title: Garbageman
videos.overview: The boys have made friends with a group of homeless, and are worried when they start mysteriously disappearing into the night!

videos.title: The Shredder Strikes (1)
videos.overview: Oroku Saki (aka the Shredder) attempts to convince Leonardo that Saki is fighting the good fight ... that he's out there carrying on the great tradition of Bushido and Ninjitsu, and the turtles should stand with him.

videos.title: The Shredder Strikes (2)
videos.overview: Our four turtles stand facing their most formidable foe to date ... the Shredder. Beaten and battle weary, the turtles get separated from one another during the martial arts mayhem and a building collapse!

videos.title: The Unconvincing Turtle Titan
videos.overview: Believing the Turtles can accomplish so much more for the city, and inspired by iconic superhero Silver Sentry, Michelangelo decides to take a crack at being a superhero.

videos.title: Notes from the Underground (1)
videos.overview: When Don's examination of some mysterious crystals attracts the attention of a subterranean monster, the Turtles underground exploration unearths a Foot Genetics Lab!

videos.title: Notes from the Underground (2)
videos.overview: After discovering an abandoned underground Foot Genetics Lab, and being attacked by once-human Digging Creatures, the Turtles assist those very creatures in trying to repair a Force Field.

videos.title: Notes from the Underground (3)
videos.overview: After befriending the once-human creatures in an abandoned underground Foot Genetics Lab, the Turtles join them on a journey deeper into the earth, where they come upon the ruins of a once-great subterranean city.

videos.title: The King
videos.overview: With all the turtles living in April's apartment, things are getting a little crazy. But, when Donatello stumbles upon a fantastic monster in the basement, things get crazier.

videos.title: The Shredder Strikes Back (1)
videos.overview: On a training run Leo is ambushed by a major Foot attack force, including Foot Tech Ninjas, their old enemy Hun, and a new threat: the Foot Elite!

videos.title: The Shredder Strikes Back (2)
videos.overview: When the Foot Ninja attack April's apartment in force, the Turtles fight against overwhelming odds to get the wounded Leo to safety.

videos.title: Tales of Leo
videos.overview: The Turtles, Splinter, Casey and April just barely manage to escape from the explosion that destroys the antique store. They hit the road and hide out at Casey's grandmother's old farmhouse, but Leonardo is badly wounded.

videos.title: The Monster Hunter
videos.overview: Still recuperating up at Casey's grandmother's farm, the turtles are feeling the sting of boredom. Luckily, a scientist known as the "Monster Hunter" has come to the area searching for a legendary monster...

videos.title: Return to New York (1)
videos.overview: The Turtles return to New York with one goal in mind: to destroy the Shredder once and for all.

videos.title: Return to New York (2)
videos.overview: The Turtles and Splinter continue to fight their way up through the Foot Headquarters skyscraper, facing down three misshapen Mutant Shredder Clones, a hallway of traps, and the Mystic Ninja.

videos.title: Return to New York (3)
videos.overview: With Stockman showing up in the middle of the final battle between our heroes and the Shredder, everything is thrown into chaos ... so much so that our heroes must join forces with the Shredder and Hun to defeat Stockman.

videos.title: Lone Raph and Cub
videos.overview: With Splinter mysteriously vanished, the Turtles are feeling frustrated, not knowing where to start looking. Impatient with strategizing, Raph heads off on his own - and straight into trouble, of the mobster kind!

videos.title: Search for Splinter (1)
videos.overview: After the frustrated Turtles exhaust their search for Splinter, their suspicions turn to the Guardians, and the trail soon leads them to a non-descript building, the initials of its company name spelling out "TCRI."

videos.title: Search for Splinter (2)
videos.overview: The Turtles successfully infiltrate the mysterious TCRI Building, where they manage to sneak into its inner sanctum, and locate the unconscious Splinter inside a stasis tank.

videos.title: Turtles in Space (1): The Fugitoid
videos.overview:
The Turtles are taken across space to the Planet D'Hoonnib - and right into the middle of a Police arrest!

They befriend Professor Honeycutt, alias The Fugitoid, who is being pursued by the military forces of General Blanque. The General wants Honeycutt's teleportation device, perhaps the only way The Turtles will reach Earth again...

videos.title: Turtles in Space (2): The Trouble with Triceratons
videos.overview: Still trapped on D'Hoonnib, the Turtles and The Fugitoid visit a seedy night club in an effort to find transportation off of the Planet. But General Blanque intercepts them, and, in the battle that follows, Fugitoid is captured by another party interested in the teleportation device...

videos.title: Turtles in Space (3): The Big House
videos.overview: Captured by the Triceratons, the Turtles are used to persuade the Fugitoid to work on his teleportation device. Trapped in a jail cell, the Turtles plot an escape plan. But will it work? And can they get to Fugitoid in time?

videos.title: Turtles in Space (4): The Arena
videos.overview: The Turtles are brought to the Tri-Sports Arena, where they have been selected to battle as Gladiators. For the Triceraton crowds, the only way to gain victory is by showing no mercy...

videos.title: Turtles in Space (5): Triceraton Wars
videos.overview: The Triceratons do battle with the General Blanque's forces and in the chaos, allow the Turtles to capture the Triceraton Prime Leader as their hostage. They prepare to return home using the Fugitoid's teleporter, but there's only one problem : he's never tested it

videos.title: Secret Origins (1)
videos.overview: The Turtles arrive inside TCRI, and are reunited with Splinter. They also find themselves facing old ghosts  as well as their origins are revealed to them at last...

videos.title: Secret Origins (2)
videos.overview: The Turtles and Splinter use Virtual Reality technology to learn of the Utrom's presence and purpose on Earth, but an old enemy believed dead returns to make the journey VERY real...

videos.title: Secret Origins (3)
videos.overview: The Turtles and Splinter escape the Utrom's virtual reality device, but now they must escape TCRI before it is destroyed. Buttheir only way out is hampered by one small obstacle: SHREDDER AND THE FOOT!

videos.title: Reflections
videos.overview: The Turtles retreat to Casey Jone's Grandmother's farm house to reflect on their recent battles. But the figure of the Shredder still haunts their every memory. What is the Shredder's connection to the Turtles origins?

videos.title: The Ultimate Ninja
videos.overview: The Ultimate Ninja, a warrior from across the galaxies, has come to take the head of Shredder - only to find Leonardo has already done the deed. So now The Ultimate Ninja challenges Leonardo in a battle to the death...

videos.title: The Return of Nano
videos.overview: When Nano returns to take revenge on the Turtles, the four brothers must stop his rampage. But this is made more difficult when Nano springs his "Father" from prison...

videos.title: What a Croc
videos.overview: The Turtles are about to discover that the Mutagen that transformed them, has had an effect on other creatures as well. They must now defend their territory from the rampage of the insidious alligator Leatherhead...

videos.title: Return to the Underground
videos.overview: The Turtles return to the underground city but they find the city is now abandoned, it's crystal moon power source missing, and it's human population reduced to monsters. Can an unstable serum created by Donatello restore the humans to normal?

videos.title: City at War (1)
videos.overview: The collapse of Shredder's crime empire means the city is open for the most vicious gangs to seize control for themselves. New York is plunged into chaos and anarchy, and only the Turtles can maintain order..or can they?

videos.title: City at War (2)
videos.overview: The Turtles are caught in a power struggle for the city : The Foot, the Purple Dragons, and the Mob, all want a piece of the pie. Are the boys able to save the city from anarchy? And is it their problem in the first place?

videos.title: City at War (3)
videos.overview: With the Foot, the Purple Dragons, and the Mob becoming more than the Turtles can handle, the TMNT reluctantly call on the help of Shredder's old General: Karai.

videos.title: Junklantis
videos.overview: Whilst testing out their new Shell Sub, the Turtles are forced to sink or swim when they discover their old enemy Garbageman is creating his own underwater city.

videos.title: The Golden Puck
videos.overview: Casey Jones joins the sport of Super Slam Hockey. However it turns personal when a legendary 17th century Golden Puck is taken by crooks. Can the Turtles hold Casey in line long enough to find the Puck, or will the hardcore rules of Super Slam Hockey get to them first?

videos.title: Rogue in the House (1)
videos.overview: Shredder deploys an army of Foot Mechs and a Cyborg duplicate of Splinter against the Turtles.

videos.title: Rogue in the House (2)
videos.overview: Shredder's army of Foot Mechs confront the Turtles, but even if they defeat this army, can they stop Shredder? And how does a Triceraton warrior called Zog fit into it all?

videos.title: April's Artifact
videos.overview: The Turtles help April unlock the secrets of an ancient Puzzle cube left behind by her father. The puzzle's solution takes April and the Turtles on a journey of discovery..to another dimension filled with giant insects!

videos.title: Return of the Justice Force
videos.overview: Michelangelo's quest to collect a rare comic take the TMNT and Casey Jones back to Northampton, Massachusetts. Here they uncover a plot by a madman to kidnap the members of a retired super-hero team called The Justice Force.

videos.title: The Big Brawl (1)
videos.overview: Every three years, Splinter leaves his students to go to parts unknown. Curious, the four Turtles decide to follow him this time. The pursuit of their master leads the Turtles into something they never expected, right into the middle of the "Big Brawl" : The Battle for the Nexus, a brutal tournament where fates will be decided...

videos.title: The Big Brawl (2)
videos.overview: The Turtles discover more about their master Splinter as the Battle Nexus tournament continues. They also have a run-in with a warrior who Splinter defeated in the tournament three years ago: Lord Draco.

videos.title: The Big Brawl (3)
videos.overview: The Battle Nexus tournament begins to take it's toll on the TMNT : Leonardo is poisoned, Splinter is framed, and Lord Draco moves closer to victory.

videos.title: The Big Brawl (4)
videos.overview: The Battle Nexus Tournament nears it's conclusion : Dontello finds himself fighting for his life with Usagi Yujumbo as Mikey is poised to become Battle Nexus Champion. Leonardo's condition worsens, and Splinter is still in prison. Worse still, Lord Draco now has control of the Daimyo Warstaff...

videos.title: Space Invaders (1)
videos.overview: The Triceratons have invaded looking for the Fugitoid. Unfortunately, no one on Earth knows what the heck the big horn heads are talking about.

videos.title: Space Invaders (2)
videos.overview: Having managed to rescue Casey and April from becoming slaves, the turtles have lost Donatello to the Triceratons. Donatello tries desperately to convince Prime Leader Zanramon that the Fugitoid is not on Earth!

videos.title: Space Invaders (3)
videos.overview: Searching for the captive Donatello, Leonardo, Raphael and Michelangelo sneak their way into Republic Central, the hub of the Triceraton Homeworld.

videos.title: Worlds Collide (1)
videos.overview: Just when the turtles think everything's under control with the Triceratons leaving fully convinced the Fugitoid is not on planet Earth, the Fugitoid shows up!

videos.title: Worlds Collide (2)
videos.overview: Just when our four turtles thought they had fooled the Triceratons and disguised the Fugitoid, they find themselves captives of the Military.

videos.title: Worlds Collide (3)
videos.overview: At the secret Federation/military base, the turtles are about to be dissected by Agent Bishop, a very bad resident of planet Earth. Luckily, our odd trio of commandos (Splinter, April and Casey) are moving in for the rescue.

videos.title: Touch and Go
videos.overview: Welcome to the New World...same as the Old World. While the Turtles attempt to assess the damage around their lair, they find that adjusting to their post alien invasion lives might be harder than they thought.

videos.title: Hunted
videos.overview: For a two ton reptile, Leatherhead actually makes the ideal houseguest; neat, tidy, always pays his rent on time... except for the fact that his temper is really out of control.

videos.title: H.A.T.E
videos.overview: Donatello, Michelangelo and Raphael come across a band of crazed, heavily armed, alien-hating Survivalists, bent upon delivering and detonating a thermo nuclear device in New York City.

videos.title: Nobody's Fool
videos.overview: When Michelangelo and Leonardo are out getting a little night air, they cross paths with a caped crusader who ends up saving their lives. The Turtles soon learn that he's really a cop who is out to get the one man who ruined his career.

videos.title: The Lesson
videos.overview: April asks the Turtles to help perfect her ninjitsu skills. But the Turtles are reluctant to do so and recount a story about how they once tried to take a "student" under their wing. They just weren't prepared to be teachers.

videos.title: The Christmas Aliens
videos.overview: Christmas is supposed to be a time of giving, not taking! But when a dangerous gang of thieves hijack a truck full of holiday toys on it's way to an orphanage, it's time for Michelanglo to start passing out some season's beatings!

videos.title: New Blood
videos.overview: The "savior" of New York City, Oroku Saki, has another face: the Shredder. The turtles stumble upon the Shredder's real reason for "helping" New York.

videos.title: The Darkness Within
videos.overview: When Angel's brother disappears in the Wall Street area, the turtles jump to help her. Turns out that, as a result of all the destruction from the invasion, an ancient horror has been stirred.

videos.title: Mission of Gravity
videos.overview: The Shredder sends Stockman and Hun on a quest to retrieve an Antigravity Generator from the city of Beijing, which is still floating in the upper atmosphere, thanks to the Triceratons.

videos.title: The Entity Below
videos.overview: The Entity and his kind are awakened through a rare planetary alignment, and, harnessing great power, they proceed to start shifting the tectonic plates in order to bring back their world.

videos.title: Time Travails
videos.overview: The turtles get sucked into a time traveling adventure by the somewhat vapid but totally cute Renet, Apprentice Timestress.

videos.title: Hun on the Run
videos.overview: Hun's always been loyal, but too many failures have tarnished his relationship with his master. But when Karai is captured by Bishop, the Shredder gives Hun a mission in which he can redeem himself: save Karai and bring her back alive.

videos.title: Reality Check
videos.overview: Ultimate Drako is back and he's causing all sorts of chaos with the Time Scepter. He's sent the four turtles spinning through time into alternate realities.

videos.title: Across the Universe
videos.overview: Because of Ultimate Drako's machinations, Raphael finds himself in an alternate reality... of the Planet Racers. This is right down Raphael's alley... until that alley turns into a dead end and he's heading right for it!

videos.title: Same as It Never Was
videos.overview: Ultimate Drako's time manipulations have sent Donatello to an alternate reality... and it's not pretty. It's one possible future, a horrible nightmare. The Shredder is all powerful.

videos.title: The Real World (1)
videos.overview: Ultimate Drako is causing trouble with the Time Scepter. He blasts Leonardo into another dimension... Usagi Yojimbo's dimension.

videos.title: The Real World (2)
videos.overview: Leonardo and Usagi arrive in the Battle Nexus hoping for a way to reunite the four turtles and their master. But they find the Battle Nexus under the control of the evil Ultimate Drako and Master Splinter is his prisoner.

videos.title: Bishop's Gambit
videos.overview: Bishop is back and making his move. His research demands a mutated specimen closer to human... a rat: Master Splinter. Bishop kidnaps Splinter and moves to finish the creation of his genetically enhanced super soldiers.

videos.title: Exodus (1)
videos.overview: Splinter receives a vision of his Master Yoshi...and a mission. He must stop the Shredder. Time is running out. He doesn't know how to explain it to his sons, but they need no explanation. They're with their father to the bitter end.

videos.title: Exodus (2)
videos.overview: The Shredder is leaving Earth in a spaceship of his own construction intent upon wreaking havoc on the Utroms and the galaxy. But he's taken on some unwanted passengers and they're not about to let the Shredder get away.

videos.title: Cousin Sid
videos.overview: The Turtles hide out at Casey's farm to recover from their battle with the Shredder. However the ghosts of Casey's past come back to haunt him when his cousin Sid arrives with a gang in tow...

videos.title: The Peoples' Choice
videos.overview: The Turtles bear witness to a rumble in the urban jungle between two alien princesses, fighting for the right to party and rule. Pistols at twenty paces. Tally ho.

videos.title: A Wing and a Prayer
videos.overview: Ascending to new heights, the Turtles aid the winged warrior named Raptarr against the renegade Mephos to save the floating city of the Avians.

videos.title: Sons of the Silent Age
videos.overview: The Turtles face a species of the deep, and when April gets too close to the action, she grasps a truth behind the current of environmental consequence.

videos.title: Dragons' Brew
videos.overview: Casey and Leo investigate a series of large-scale robberies. Not surprisingly, Hun and the Purple Dragon are to blame. However one of their hauls is a crate that should never have been opened!

videos.title: I, Monster
videos.overview: Casey and the Turtles are practising their hide-and-seek skills at an abandoned warehouse complex. All the while, a strangely familiar figure watches them from the shadows - with an army of rats at his command!

videos.title: Grudge Match
videos.overview: A return to the Battle Nexus, a time to fight, is Mikey bound for glory once more?

videos.title: All Hallows Theives
videos.overview: On Halloween night, a mustachioed man visits April, expressing interest in a rather unusual item: a hideous six-armed idol. But the statue is no ordinary junkshop knickknack; it can be used to invoke a horde of imps that proceed to clean out the city and bring its spoils to their master, a criminal who calls himself The King of Thieves.

videos.title: Bad Day
videos.overview: The Turtles learn first hand what it means to have a "Bad Shell Day" as calamity after calamity befalls them. This time the Turtles may not be able to save everybody...

videos.title: Aliens Among Us
videos.overview: When the President of the United States arrives in New York City, an invasion of what seems to be aliens attacks at the most inconvenient time. However, the Turtles investigate this "invasion" and find out that  Bishop is behind it. The question is - why?

videos.title: Dragons Rising
videos.overview: The Purple Dragons have evolved from a basic street gang to a smuggling syndicate that works throughout New York. Leonardo goes with Casey to put an end to Hun's plans. However, Casey and the recently angry Leo will have to control their own fury if they want to bring justice-- and not just veangeance-- out of this.

videos.title: Still Nobody
videos.overview: The Turtles help Nobody protect an old man when he witnesses Jengo, leader of the Turks, harming a Turks member. Can the Turtles and Nobody stop the Turks?

videos.title: Samurai Tourist
videos.overview: Usagi and Gen come to New York for a visit with the Turtles. Gen gets a little carried away by the bright lights of the big city and goes wandering off on his own. And if the modern world wasn't dangerous enough, an assassin from Usagi's world has followed Usagi and Gen. His target: Leonardo.

videos.title: The Ancient One
videos.overview: It is time for Leonardo to move on. Splinter sends Leo to a new sensei, or rather, a very old sensei. The journey is long and perilous. Can Leonardo look into himself and find the right answers to his questions? Can he even find the right questions?

videos.title: Scion of the Shredder
videos.overview: While Leonardo is in Japan studying with the Ancient One, Karai as the new Shredder makes her attack. Will Leo return to New York? Will he find out what happened to his home and his family? And, have Splinter and Turtles really been destroyed?

videos.title: Prodigal Son
videos.overview: Leonardo returns from Japan to find the lair in ruins and his family nowhere to be seen. As he investigates he finds that the Foot is back to full strength - with Karai as their leader. Since the Foot believe Leo to be dead, he puts all that he has learnt from the Anicent One into practice...

videos.title: Outbreak
videos.overview: Bishop has too deal with the consequenses of his actions when people and animals all over New York starts mutating into horrible beasts after his "alien" invasion.

videos.title: The Trouble with Augie
videos.overview: For several years April's uncle Augustus (aka Augie) has been missing.

videos.title: A Tale of Master Yoshi
videos.overview: When the power goes out in their lair, the Turtles and Splinter gather around the candlelight as Leonardo tells a story he learned from the Ancient One about Splinter's sensei, Hamato Yoshi.

videos.title: The Return of Savanti (1)
videos.overview: Savanti Romero plots his revenge against the Turtles and Renet after they had him banished to the Cretaceous period. Using his magic to manipulate time, Romero lures the Turtles and Renet into a trap to obtain the time sceptre.

videos.title: The Return of Savanti (2)
videos.overview: Having travelled to the past, the Turtles and Renet battle with Savanti Romero and his telepathically controlled dinosaurs as Savanti attempts to change the historic timeline by preventing the dinosaur extinction event.

videos.title: Adventures in Turtlesitting
videos.overview: With the outbreak-mutant situation the Turtles feel they have to deal with and Donatello sick his brothers leave him with Casey and April for care. But Donatello is not sick but in the last stages of a second mutation.

videos.title: Good Genes (1)
videos.overview: With Donatello sick the Turtles are desperate. So desperate that they decide  to try and sneak into Bishops facility, where they realize they have to make a deal with the devil if they want to cure Donatello

videos.title: Good Genes (2)
videos.overview: To cure Donatello the Turtles made a deal with the devil aka Bishop. Now they have to retrive a pendant that is supposed to help Bishop in his research. The thing is that the pendant is in the heart of the Foot-building, and Karai won't just hand it over

videos.title: The Ninja Tribunal
videos.overview: After the Turtles were able to cure Donatello's mutation, a group of ninjas confronts the Turtles to tell them about a battle between good and evil that will decide the fate of the world.

videos.title: Lap of the Gods
videos.overview: The Ninja Tribunal has called on eight acolytes to stop the coming evil. But first they have to train and be taught some important lessons that may mean the difference between life and death.

videos.title: Demons and Dragons
videos.overview: The Turtles begin training with the mysterious Ninja Tribunal, experimenting with new powers and weapons. After securing the first of the Tribunal’s Lost Artifacts, our heroes learn to their horror that the “great evil” they are destined to face is the long-imprisoned spirit of the one, true Shredder!

videos.title: Legend of the 5 Dragons
videos.overview: The Turtles train with the Ninja Tribunal to prevent the resurrection of the Shredder. But when Splinter and the Ancient One express serious doubts about trusting the Tribunal, the Turtles are confused. If they all agree on the goal, why the doubts? To explain the danger to the Turtles, Splinter and the Ancient One reveal the secret history of the Tribunal… including the true origin of the Shredder!

videos.title: More Worlds Than One
videos.overview: The Turtles and company continue their training under the Ninja Tribunal, learning to fight in the physical as well as mental and spiritual worlds. They’re going to need that knowledge, because the second artefact of the Shredder has been found, guarded by a horde of nasty Tengu demons that eat Acolytes for breakfast… literally!

videos.title: Beginning of the End
videos.overview: Returning to the Tribunal Monastery with the second Shredder Artefact, things seem to be going well for our heroes when – deception! Old foes infiltrate the Monastery. With all three artefacts in the hands of evil, they plan a sneak attack on the Tribunal and their students with devastating results!

videos.title: Membership Drive
videos.overview: The Justice Force is expanding its ranks, and Mikey plans on joining up as Turtle Titan!, while Leo is more concerned in alerting them to the threat of the original Shredder. But when Nano reappears (thanks to Bishop and Baxter Stockman), everything quickly spirals out of control into a super hero vs. nanotech slugfest! But has Nano come back as friend or foe? And will the Turtle Titan and Leo survive long enough to find out?

videos.title: New World Order (1)
videos.overview: The original Shredder is resurrected by the Foot Mystics, whose first agenda is to destroy Karai – the “false Shredder.” And, while the Turtles are enemies of both Shredders, they realize that if the original Shredder wins, his goal of creating a world of destruction, devastation and chaos will be one huge step closer to reality. So, like it or not, they have to help Karai – even while she’s intent on killing them!

videos.title: New World Order (2)
videos.overview: In their attempt to rescue Karai from the Foot Mystics and new Shredder, the Turtles wind up in a raging battle filled with magic and martial arts where they use everything the Tribunal taught them - but will it be enough to escape with Karai and their lives?

videos.title: Fathers and Sons
videos.overview: Weary after their first battle with the new Shredder, the Turtles doubt they can defeat him. To lift their spirits, Splinter and the Ancient One shares a tale of the Turtles’ toddler days. The story reveals that though the Turtles were small, they overcame impossible odds to defeat a phantom bent on reviving the Shredder, though they may not remember it.

videos.title: Past and Present
videos.overview: Shredder begins to build a new dynasty in New York, transforming the whole island into a hellish nightmare.

videos.title: Enter the Dragons (1)
videos.overview: The demonic Shredder has transformed New York City into a nightmare version of Feudal Japan and the rest of the modern world is next! But the Turtles have a plan, and if it takes allying themselves with some of their former enemies to bring the fight to the Shredder, so be it... because if they fail, all life as they known it will cease to exist.

videos.title: Enter the Dragons (2)
videos.overview: With the help of their closest allies and most dangerous enemies alike, the Turtles have fought their way through a demonic version of New York to confront the Shredder once and for all! Now the Turtles must have everything they've got and have no choice but to focus their energy and become their very own mystic avatars...Dragons. This night, the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles will meet their destinies: Whether to live or die!

videos.title: Future Shellshock
videos.overview: The Turtles and Splinter find themselves in a futuristic world after accidentally being pulled through a time window.

videos.title: Obsolete
videos.overview: The Turtles use new technology to create new weapons in an effort to escape the future.

videos.title: Home Invasion
videos.overview: A computer virus traps the Turtles inside the Dojo and they must fight for their lives.

videos.title: Headlock Prime
videos.overview: Raph competes in a professional wrestling tournament, which is interrupted by a banned wrestler looking to prove himself.

videos.title: Playtime's Over
videos.overview: Mikey is excited when a video game sequel is released; the Turtles need a guide to navigate the mall.

videos.title: Bishop to Knight
videos.overview: The Turtles find out that Agent Bishop is alive in the year 2105.

videos.title: Night of Sh'okanabo!
videos.overview: Mikey brings Cody and his three friends to a horror film festival, where they meet Sh'okanabo face to face.

videos.title: Clash of the Turtle Titans
videos.overview: Mikey discovers that someone has taken his old superhero persona, Turtle Titan.

videos.title: Fly Me to the Moon
videos.overview: Cody and the Turtles search for a rare alloy on the moon; Inuwashi Gunjin goes there to make sure they do not return alive.

videos.title: Invasion of the Body Snatcher!
videos.overview: Jammerhead uses the Bodyjacker to take over Darius Dun's body to steal O'Neil Tech's secrets.

videos.title: The Freaks Come Out at Night
videos.overview: Sh'Okanabo implants gene seeds in Mikey, beginning his first test of introducing the seeds into the general population.

videos.title: Bad Blood
videos.overview: The Turtles' psychotic clones try to prove that they are bigger, badder and better than the Turtles.

videos.title: The Journal
videos.overview: The Turtles come across April and Casey's old future-history journal.

videos.title: The Gaminator
videos.overview: Viral sets a trap that digitizes and sucks the Turtles into a prototype game system, the Gaminator.

videos.title: Graduation Day: Class of 2105
videos.overview: Splinter announces that the Turtles will graduate to the next ninja rank, except Michelangelo.

videos.title: Timing Is Everything
videos.overview: Sh'Okanabo unleashes a time storm on New York, putting the Turtles in the middle of chaos.

videos.title: Enter the Jammerhead
videos.overview: Jammerhead escapes from prison and confronts the Turtles during a visit from Starlee's alien family.

videos.title: Milk Run
videos.overview: An intergalactic mercenary enlists the Turtles' help in smuggling a ship full of humanitarian aid past Triceraton gangsters.

videos.title: The Fall of Darius Dunn
videos.overview: When Cody uncovers a secret weapons-manufacturing program, he and his uncle have a showdown over who will ultimately control the O'Neilltech empire.

videos.title: Turtle X-Tinction
videos.overview: Darius Dunn controls Turtle X to exact revenge on his nephew and the Turtles.

videos.title: Race for Glory
videos.overview: Triple Threat crashes a cross-country road race and steals all the cars.

videos.title: Head of State
videos.overview: The Turtles must rescue the president before he loses his head to a sinister figure from their past.

videos.title: DNA Is Thicker Than Water
videos.overview: Dark Leo tries to prove himself by destroying the Turtles from within.

videos.title: The Cosmic Completist
videos.overview: The leader of Inawashi Gunjin asks the turtles for help with a malicious alien.

videos.title: The Day of Awakening
videos.overview: When the entire population of Moonbase Bishop goes missing and the Turtles stage an assault on the base, they find a bigger Sh'Okanabo with an army of drones.

videos.title: Zixxth Sense
videos.overview: Torbin Zixx persuades the turtles to help him recover an experimental matter transmitter.

videos.title: Tempus Fugit
videos.overview: When the Time Window is repaired, the Turtles enter it to go home, but instead of ending up back at the lair they are sent on a harrowing trip through the past, present and future.

videos.title: Karate Schooled
videos.overview: The Turtles are reunited with Casey and April; Casey is brainwashed by his new martial arts instructor.

videos.title: Something Wicked
videos.overview: The Turtles journey into cyberspace as Cybernauts on a mission to save as much of Master Splinter as they can find.

videos.title: The Engagement Ring
videos.overview: The engagement ring Casey and Raph pick out for April has powers that Hun and the Purple Dragons want.

videos.title: Hacking Stockman
videos.overview: While Don collects Splinter's data bits, his brothers are pulled into a war between the Foot and the Purple Dragons.

videos.title: The Incredible Shrinking Serling
videos.overview: Serling, desperate to return to his own time, builds a makeshift Time Window.

videos.title: Identity Crisis
videos.overview: Cyber Shredder releases a virus that wipes out the turtles' memories.

videos.title: Web Wranglers
videos.overview: The Cyber Shredder creates a web portal that will allow him to travel from cyberspace into the real world.

videos.title: Superquest
videos.overview: The Turtles find more of Splinter's lost data bits, but they are embedded in the interface of Mikey's favorite online video game, SuperQuest.

videos.title: Virtual Reality Check
videos.overview: Shredder makes the turtles believe they have left cyberspace, when they are really still there giving him important information about how to build a portal.

videos.title: City Under Siege
videos.overview: The Shredder hacks into a computer grid and reprograms every electronic device in New York.

videos.title: Super Power Struggle
videos.overview: The Justice Force asks Raph to join their ranks after he gets a cape that gives him super powers.

videos.title: Wedding Bells and Bytes
videos.overview: The Turtles and Master Splinter get ready for April and Casey's wedding.
